import sys

MOD = 1_000_000_007

def solve():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    prev = [0] * (n + 1)
    cur = [0] * (n + 1)
    tWays = 0
    prev[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, 2 * n):
        cur[0] = prev[1]
        cur[n] = prev[n - 1]
        for k in range(1, n):
            cur[k] = (prev[k - 1] + prev[k + 1]) % MOD
        if i % 2 == 1:
            limit = min(i, 2 * n - i)
            for k in range(limit + 1):
                tWays = (tWays + cur[k]) % MOD
        prev, cur = cur, prev
    print(tWays)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
